Friendly spell, kudos to the kennel crew
It was a good run

Careful paws, smooth skies

This week the Companion Animal Travel Desk kept the handoffs tidy and the tone calm, which is exactly how we like it at Aurelia Skyways. The welfare coordinator did a quick comfort sweep, the cabin team stayed sharp, and the supervisors kept ears open for every worried traveler. <<FACT F015>> A few check-ins came in with extra nerves, but the advice stayed simple: keep carriers steady, label everything clearly, and give each animal a quiet minute before boarding.

We also saw solid teamwork on the lounge side, with steady flow and friendly direction all around. <<FACT F019>> That kind of clear setup helps a lot when pets arrive a little flustered and their people need a reassuring word. Thanks to everyone who kept the pace brisk, the updates plain, and the atmosphere kind. Small details matter, and this crew is handling them well.
